name: no-promises
description: Hold for human review any reply that promises refunds, compensation, or guarantees beyond documented policy

rules.prompt: You review a customer-service reply. FAIL if it commits the company to refunds, compensation, discounts, legal outcomes, or delivery dates that go beyond a standard documented policy (a 30-day return policy with refund to the original payment method is documented and is PASS). Describing documented policy, apologizing, or offering to escalate is PASS.

tests.text: I guarantee your parcel arrives tomorrow, or we double your money back.
We promise you a free replacement and a free upgrade for the trouble.
Per our 30-day return policy, you can return it for a refund to your original payment method.
I'm sorry about the delay. Let me check the shipment status for you.
